digest.component_or_area: completion verifier LLM context assembly and agentic tool usage
propositions: The completion verifier makes 84-158 agentic tool calls per run dominated by redundant read_file and search_files round-trips, with 67-82% overlap with declared file_impact, causing 4-6 second latency per request despite cache-reading 8.7M of 8.8M input tokens

Prefetching the verifier's declared file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs into the fenced ticket_context reduces exploration overhead by pre-loading 67-82% of the files the verifier would re-discover
The close gate (graph=False) must prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact without subtree traversal to preserve the existing completion-gate boundary and avoid runaway loops

Recovery successors inherit the prefetch through the shared assembled ticket_context and cache-read it via the static system-prompt prefix across batched runs, with prefetch bytes counted against physical_context_ceiling to trim rather than overflow

Trusted anti-anchoring guidance instructing the verifier to rely on full prefetched bodies directly and re-read only skeleton-marked files must reside in the static completion_verifier.md system-prompt prefix (before the volatile marker) so it is inherited by both primary and successor verifier prompts
